The '''Sev Tok system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sev Tok/Legends|Sev Tok]].<ref name="EAOC" />
